event_description: State of emergency for severe winter storms with high winds, flooding and landslides in 13 western Oregon counties; six southern Oregon counties added December 14

Executive Order 06-01, determination of a state of emergency in 24 counties due to severe weather and flooding beginning December 22, 2005 (verbally proclaimed January 13, 2006, signed January 17, 2006; Oregon Bulletin February 2006).
